Files below were flagged by automated grep for terms that MAY contradict the owner's core spec.
**Not all matches are bad training data.** Some files QUOTE these terms specifically to REJECT them
(owner's own words correcting assistant errors). Those are marked GOOD SIGNAL below.

- **CONTRADICTS SPEC — strip from training data**: File ASSERTS a false claim as fact
- **GOOD SIGNAL — owner rejection**: File QUOTES the bad claim IN ORDER TO REJECT IT (valuable training data)
- **CONTEXT NEEDED — review before including**: Ambiguous; human review recommended
